title: Build the procedural voxel world foundation
abstract:
## World foundation only

This draft deliberately remains focused on the procedural world. Machinery, progression, NPCs, towns, and other gameplay systems are deferred until the terrain foundation is visually and technically strong.

### Implemented

- Deterministic 7×7 full-detail voxel chunk world with coherent multiscale terrain
- Continuous carved river with sandbanks and an extended water surface
- One-draw-call coarse distant-terrain ring extending beyond the camera far plane
- Atmospheric horizon blending that hides full-detail chunk boundaries
- World-space moisture and temperature fields
- Elevation-aware terrain tinting with per-vertex climate interpolation
- Deterministic habitat-weighted trees, boulders, and ground cover
- Deterministic nearest-first terrain scheduling and active residency deltas
- Runtime exploration anchor converts world position to signed chunk coordinates
- Crossing a chunk boundary automatically reconciles terrain residency
- Water, vegetation, and distant terrain recenter with the same active window
- One-chunk movement retains 42 chunks, loads seven, and unloads seven
- Runtime shifts now execute through a deterministic per-frame queue
- One incoming chunk and one outgoing chunk are processed per frame instead of a seven-chunk render-thread burst
- Stale queued work is replaced when the requested world center changes again
- Per-frame streaming work time and completion totals are emitted as `WORLD_STREAM` diagnostics
- Streamed features remain five batched instances; total completed scene budget remains 56 render instances
- Correct neighbor-aware greedy meshing and back-face winding
- Four deterministic CI views: hero valley, river corridor, upland terrain, and a real post-shift streaming capture
- Three original visual target mockups under `docs/visual-targets`
- Survival-only project constraint; no creative mode

### Latest reviewed validation

- Head commit: `3622279274a0baddf623e76aba75c7b86901acb4`
- CI run: `29799515378` / run #60
- Result: project import, deterministic tests, stream-budget regression tests, four rendered world captures, and Android ARM64 debug export all passed
- Shifted screenshot artifact inspected at full resolution
- No missing terrain, water gap, duplicate feature layer, overlap band, or horizon seam was found in the shifted capture
- Initial synchronous build remains intentionally unchanged so the first rendered frame and QA capture are complete
- Runtime one-chunk shifts are now distributed across seven frames

### Next world-foundation work

- Move chunk generation and greedy mesh data preparation onto worker threads while keeping scene-tree and RenderingServer mutations on the main thread
- Add terrain collision and a grounded exploration controller
- Add physical-device frame-time telemetry and verify the Vivo T3x target
- Continue improving vegetation meshes and terrain micro-detail after streaming is structurally correct

Cloud-runner timing is diagnostic evidence only. The 50 FPS target on the Vivo T3x 6 GB remains unverified until there is physical-device evidence.
